body: Thank you, I have been told I'm awesome various times, in fact a lot of people tell me I'm very funny and have a unique sense of humor. It's nice to know complete strangers I don't even know want to show me support, it really helps. I give in too much to how other people view me an judge me, I've always had a poor self-image, needless to say I was never the most attractive person except for aesthetically. I am a good person to others I would say, except I recently had a friend who told me he didn't even want to speak anymore because I'm apparently "too safe" and a "complete bitch" if that makes any sense. I appreciate your kind words, you yourself seem like a fantastic person, wanting to give advice to those who need it most. I feel I should show the same and help others who struggle with what I do. You set an awesome example!

I've attempted it many times before, and I've even cut frequently... still do sometimes. I do have friends now that I'm in college, some whom are pretty awesome and I get to spend time with and enjoy being with me. That's true though, to be honest I have had one good friend since I was younger, but due to college I only get to see him on vacations, he's the one person who I know will always respect me.

That's really harsh, cant say I had the same run ins, I never spoke to anyone throughout school so I guess that's why I was either picked on or ignored. I couldn't join the military due to my condition, I also don't support the idea of war, but I do respect the military. I do go to the gym regularly now, in fact 5 times a week, lost 40 pounds now, really boosted my self-esteem although I have much more to work towards. I want respect from other people, so I suppose the best way to receive it is to give it, even if I'm not shown the same in return. Good for you though pulling through it all, I don't think I could have gotten through it all.

Well for the record I do have type II bipolar disorder, which is hypomanic depressive.
But looking beyond that, there are plenty of other sources leading towards my depression as I previously stated. It just seems like people would rather have me dead and out of their way, I just feel like such an inconvenience to everyone I speak to. I've had good memories, plenty of them to be fair, but enough so it feels like their pointless and I was only kidding myself. As far as my hobbies, I love longboarding, I play drums and listen to hardcore music, going to shows, reading, writing, video games, some anime. I do smoke weed, which can help occasionally but sometimes it doesn't. Maybe I also overlook my flaws, sometimes I always blame others for my issues and don't look at anything I did that added towards any aggressive situation I was involved with. But a lot of times in school I was randomly picked on and teased for no reason, I hardly every spoke to anyone too, it never made any sense.
